page.notes: The word "author" in verse 16 stands in small type inside the line, between "pacis" and "semper"; it is transcribed in place, not as a margin note. Only a small stray mark at the right edge near the end of the page was seen; it is not transcribed. The first word "traneum" is doubtful: the long s may make it "transeum". Long s read as s throughout (usum, esse, sit, ministerium), so the scan's f-shaped letters are not f.
